items.title: Sandisk Stock Is Getting Its Mojo Back Amid China Memory-Chip Move
items.summary: Sandisk  stock is on a hot streak and may finally be getting its mojo back.  The shares are on a five-day winning streak through Friday, jumping 35% in that time.  Sandisk was moving in tandem with other memory stocks, including  Western Digital Seagate  and  Micron  ahead of the open Monday.

items.title: Intel, Oracle, Marvell, Alibaba, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Nvidia Leads 5 Stocks In Buy Areas, Sandisk Nears Key Level; Walmart Looms
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq look ready to run, but they haven't quite done so. Sandisk surged but must do this. Walmart, Target loom.

items.title: 1 Cash-Producing Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Find Risky
items.summary: Generating cash is essential for any business, but not all cash-rich companies are great investments. Some produce plenty of cash but fail to allocate it effectively, leading to missed opportunities.

items.title: SanDisk Has Delivered A Return The Index Cannot, And The Swings That Come With It
items.summary: Its correlation to the market is only moderate, so much of what it does is genuinely its own, but the stock has moved several times as far as the index in both directions.

items.summary: J.P. Morgan resumes coverage of Sandisk stock while Citi doubles down on its bullish call on the heels of the storage provider’s investor day.
